---
title: "Thehri Hui Hai Hasnain Mehdi"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Manqabat"
poet: "Asad"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Jahan Aal-e-Abba Thehri Hoi Hai.
Wahin Zaat-e-Khuda Thehri Hoi Hai.
Galay Shabbir Se Hur Mil Raha Hai.
Kahin Pichey Khata Thehri Hoi Hai.

2
Kiya Hai Jab Se Majlis Ka Iradah.
Merey Ghar Fatima Thehri Hoi Hai.
Tabasum Par Ali Asghar Ke Ab Tak.
Nigah-e-Kibriya Thehri Hoi Hai.

3
Yeh Dil Hai Matami Ka Our Iss Mein.
Riza-e-Fatima Thehri Hoi Hai.
Farishtay Hi Nahi Banney Ko Zair.
Qatar-e-Anbiya Thehri Hoi Hai.

4
Aye Rahib Our Betay Mang Sheh Se.
Teri Khatir Atta Thehri Hoi Hai.
Kisaye Fatima Zahra Hai, Jis Mein.
Shifa e Mustafa Thehri Hoi Hai.

5
Rakhay Jo Bugz Shah-e-La Fata Se.
Woh Nasal-e-La Pata Thehri Hoi Hai.
 Asad Khak-e-Shifa Ka Faiz Hai Jo.
Zamane Mein Shifa Thehri Hoi Hai.

assert '\\u200c' not in body

p = 'src/data/lyrics/thehri-hui-hai-hasnain-mehdi-tajpoints-73aed201aa609652710c.md'

        assert header == number and len(verses) == 4
        assert all(verse and verse == verse.strip() and not verse.endswith('.') for verse in verses)
assert '\\u200c' not in body
print('Verified indentation and 20 aligned verse positions across five stanzas.')

Reconstructed all 20 verses in Urdu script and verified their alignment with the five stanzas in `romanLyrics`. Preserved the Roman wording, set the Urdu title and right-to-left direction, and removed `noUrdu`.

I read the ambiguous Roman “Aal-e-Abba” as **آلِ عبا** based on the poem’s context.
